verdict.rationale: Bolt's built-in Database docs explicitly describe scaffolding email sign-up ('users sign up using their email address') and Supabase integration adds broader 'Authentication services' when connected, so basic auth scaffolding is documented. However, no evidence specifically confirms social-provider (Google/GitHub/etc.) login scaffolding is generated by the builder—only generic 'authentication services' is mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of social/OAuth provider sign-up being scaffolded, and independent/hands-on confirmation that generated auth flows work reliably.
